summary: Kinder Morgan, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an underwritten public offering of $1.75 billion aggregate principal amount of senior notes: $1.15 billion 5.550% notes due 2036 and $600 million 6.150% notes due 2056. The notes are guaranteed under a cross guarantee agreement and were sold under a shelf registration statement. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including repaying commercial paper and refinancing maturities. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. Underwriters include BofA Securities and others. No special-situation relevance; watch for typical debt issuance details.
